_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. NOTE: this pipeline calls sec-form4-insider-tracker, whose own per-event charges also bill the buyer. The Form 4 child is EDGAR HTTP (no browser, no proxy) and the 13D/13G stage is inline EDGAR, so compute per run is tiny and these prices stay well above it. Free tier kept to 1 activist_confirmed so any run with billable rows covers compute.

watch.eventDescription: One passive 13G large-holder filing with no insider buying in the window. Includes the filer, filing type, filing link, and the insider buy/sell tally.

accumulation.eventDescription: A 13D activist filing, or any large-holder filing with insider open-market buying in the window. Includes filer, intent, filing detail, and the insider buy/sell counts and dollar values.

activist_confirmed.eventDescription: A recent Schedule 13D (intent to influence), optionally with net insider open-market buying in the window. An activist taking a stake while insiders also buy. Includes full filing and insider buy detail. The first activist confirmed per run is free so you can validate output.
